The hens are kept in a coop behind the house, and they are let out every morning at first light and shut in again at dusk. In the winter they lay fewer eggs, but this is the summer and they are laying well. I sell the eggs at the market by the dozen, and I keep some back for the house and for my neighbours. Last week a fox came near the coop but did not get in, and none of the hens was lost, so I still have all twelve of them. My question is about the week just gone. Is it true that they laid 84 eggs?
